prompt: This test has no assertions. Why is that a problem?
choices: The test will always pass even if add() is broken
Tests with no assertions cause compilation errors
JUnit requires at least one assertTrue
The method name must start with 'assert'
explanation: A test with no assertions always passes unless an exception is thrown. Even if add() returns the wrong answer or infinite loop, the test 'passes'. Fix: assertEquals(5, c.add(2, 3));
